# mdlink

<!-- Generated by `tbx gen` from tool.toml. Do not edit. -->

Print a markdown link for a file, relative to the workspace root

Version 0.1.0. Language sh. Platforms macos, linux.

## Usage

```
mdlink [options] <path> [text]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | File or directory path, optionally with :LINE or :LINE-END |
| `text` | no | Link text (default: the workspace-relative path) |

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--root <root>` | string |  | Workspace root (default: the main checkout of the current repo) |
| `-y, --no-input` | bool |  | Disable all prompts |
| `--json` | bool |  | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout |
| `-h, --help` | bool |  | Show help, as JSON with --json |
